proposals.root_cause: When waiting_state == GATE_CLEAR_HOLD_UNSAFE and DYN-GATE-1 approaches at -0.80 m/s, Priority 2 (SAFETY_MARGIN_VIOLATION) selects v=0.0 standstill (e.g. pred_c=0.1198 m at t=6.75 s) and blocks Priority 3 reverse recovery / Priority 4 lateral holding pose, pinning the robot at the gate entrance until collision at t=7.10 s.
proposals.smallest_architectural_improvement: In DWAPlanner.compute_command(), when waiting_state == GATE_CLEAR_HOLD_UNSAFE and an oncoming obstacle is closing on the robot, do not let a near-zero-speed Priority 2 standstill override lateral holding pose (Priority 4) or reverse recovery (Priority 3); additionally trigger proactive gate-approach standoff before entering x >= 7.5 m when an obstacle is detected inside the gate.
proposals.acceptance_criteria: NARROW-GATE Level 1 goal rate improves from 42.9% to >= 90% with 0.15 m safety margin preserved and zero regression on the 8 baseline scenarios.

proposals.causally_feasible: partially (passing around stopped obstacle in 7m channel is feasible; predicting hidden reversal from 0.17m behind is not)
proposals.root_cause: Robot creeps up to pred_c=0.1503 m (swept=0.1743 m) directly behind stopped DYN-SUDDEN-1 in a 7.0 m-wide channel (y in [4, 11]). When the hidden STOP_AND_GO timer expires and DYN-SUDDEN-1 reverses at -1.2 m/s, causal observation sees it 0.05 s later at 0.056 m clearance — physically too close to escape.
proposals.smallest_architectural_improvement: Allow proactive A* lateral passing around a stationary obstacle in wide channels (y in [4, 11], 7.0 m wide) before parking at 0.15 m behind it, rather than waiting for deadlock_timeout_s=2.5 s while creeping to the 0.15 m boundary.
proposals.acceptance_criteria: SUDDEN-STOP Level 1 goal rate improves from 66.7% to >= 90% without using hidden STOP_AND_GO schedules.

proposals.root_cause: Initial heading perturbation (+/-0.26 rad) causes late/partial lateral offset (y=7.20 m at v=1.55 m/s, swept_c=0.154 m behind DYN-CORR-1) instead of full lane separation (y=6.5 or 8.5 m), leading to collision at t=17.30 s when DYN-CORR-1 bounces.
proposals.smallest_architectural_improvement: Require full lateral separation clearance in CorridorPassingManager and prevent high-speed (1.55 m/s) diagonal tailgating at <0.25 m clearance inside corridors.
proposals.acceptance_criteria: CORRIDOR__L1-IC-02__01 and 02 achieve GOAL_REACHED with >= 0.15 m clearance.

proposals.root_cause: Under max_linear_speed_mps=2.2, robot stops at x=5.36 m for crossing DYN-MULTI-2 while DYN-MULTI-1 (+1.1 m/s) approaches from behind and collides at t=11.50 s.
proposals.smallest_architectural_improvement: Include lateral-evasion preference in Priority 2/4 when an active obstacle behind the robot is closing along the same axis.

proposals.root_cause: Corridor width 2.80 m leaves 1.00 m side gaps around r=0.40 m obstacle — zero slack above 2*r_rob + 2*margin = 1.00 m, infeasible under 0.20 m discrete grid inflation.
proposals.smallest_architectural_improvement: Do NOT relax 0.15 m safety margin; classify as geometrically borderline/infeasible under 0.20 m grid resolution.
